summary: Document the GLM Spark MTP precision contract and the paired Spark/QAD prefill comparison
details: The GLM online-loading guide states that Spark stores eleven MTP projections in MXFP8 and the MTP routed experts in NVFP4 W4A16, and that the example manifest selects exactly those projections.
The prefill report keeps the raw paired TP2 timings of Spark and the online QAD recipe with shared gate/up activation scales. No serving code changes.
